text: Ledger-keeping legal services such as notary and registry services, legal motions practice in court, and legal title companies are likely to be among the first services to disappear.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3071378

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America

abstract: Forms of keeping legal ledgers such as notary and registry services, legal motions practice in court, legal title companies, among several others, may be among the first services to disappear in the not too distant future.

value: services whose core function is keeping a legal ledger
